saw_lines: Nail buyers pick one polish brand that gets the job done, then rebuy it every season without comparing.
So the sale is won in the first line of the ad, before a buyer reads on or leaves to compare.
5 of your 11 copy ads open on one line, so run two or three new angles from your own range against that opener, starting with the 3in1 shade.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: 5 of your 11 copy ads open on “diese trendfarben brauchst du diesen...”, so five ads repeat one story to the same people. Name two or three new angles from your own range and run each against that opener.
Your site answers how orders ship, yet 0 of 17 ads mention shipping, so a new buyer has to leave the ad to learn it. Put one line on delivery time in the opening line of ads for new buyers.
One identical copy runs in 5 of your 11 copy ads, so the test cannot show which message works. Keep the body text, change the opening line to a new angle, and cut a different clip for each.

None of your 17 ads shows a proof number, so a cold buyer has nothing to trust before the click. Pick one number you can stand behind, like the review count or orders shipped, and open three ads with it.

ads_1: Fresh autumn shade hooks and the 3in1 range, tested against the current opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
